text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, well, you've certainly made quite a lot of progress on your mascot research.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's about time for some practical application...
Oh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"It's no gooood.
My brain's gonna explode, sheeeesh."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Let us take a break.
Pushing yourself too hard will not resolve the situa—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see~. So you were invited to the shopping district's 50th-anniversary event,
but it looks like nobody's going to show up.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, we want to gather enough people to bring back
the bustling energy the shopping district once had.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a special anniversary, after all.
Let's scare away the gloom and bring back that old warmth, you know?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, hoh!
Isn't this... purely a matter for Mar-chan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Helping with events as a mascot, getting
people to remember Machan—it's a win-win.
Please let me help by all means.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's the shopping district's 50th-anniversary event~
Come on down, everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's a mini-live and even a raffle,
so much to do! I'm super excited~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No one's passing by, are they?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I hear foot traffic dropped around here too,
ever since a big commercial facility opened nearby...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're here.
Looking forward to working with youuu...

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no thanks...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...The hurried steps, the looking down.
It's possible people assumed you were a part-timer
handing out tissues or flyers."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, well... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Gathering people at a time like this is what
a mascot is for~
In other words, it's a job for Chan-Me~."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I see... That makes sense.
Our racing silks are our trademark.
So this is the optimal solution to draw attention, then."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
With this, you smile like this and—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
High five.
Perfect.
choice_data_list: It's the fruit of your research!
It's the fruit of your research!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
Then we should probably go get changed too, right!?

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Huh, could you be an active Umamusume!?
That's a racing suit... Wow, so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that takes me back.
Umamusume used to come running through this
shopping district during their training back in the day, too..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
When a kid who grew up in the neighborhood won her first race,
the entire shopping district celebrated, as I recall.

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll take a peek inside for old time's sake... Oh! It's the lady from the fish shop! How nostalgic, she's still keeping the store going!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: T-Thank goodness...! There really were customers coming, right!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The people from the shopping district said
it brought back fond memories for them as well.
choice_data_list: It's a huge success, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's perfect today.
However, I need to push even further.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From the shopping district's local mascot to a world-renowned mascot.
Chan-me's ambitions are blazing brightly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a world-famous mascot...!
Then could what happens today end up
being a super rare event in the future?

Even an ordinary, minor moment in the shopping district
might one day become a sight you realize you could only have seen back then.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a commemorative photo?
If I become an even greater presence...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing.
Aside from that, please make sure to record it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, um... I'm Aston Machan.
Today, I helped out at the shopping district's
50th anniversary event.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And this is Aston Machan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're the person who'll one day become the trainer
of the world's number one mascot... right?

I gave a firm nod to her question.
Then, I saved a memo on the smartphone she held out:
"I am Scarlet Machet's Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Renting out a huge venue that can hold a big crowd
for an all-out Chan-themed event
might also be an option.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, someday this place
might become a pilgrimage site,
and tons of people will visit after all...
choice_data_list: So basically, a huge crowd is going to be on the move.
So a ton of people are going to be on the move, huh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ah, but...
There is one thing I want you not to forget.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even if I become famous,
Aston Machan will always be by your side.
I won't ever make you feel like I'm far away.

Seeing her lean in and peer at my face with a 'Right?',
I couldn't help but chuckle. The curious closeness
felt remarkably comforting.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... No. For some reason,
fun memories are just so easy to forget, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Still, rather than feeling sad, I’d rather you remember that ‘Machan was cute today.’”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Or something like that.

True, that might be right.
Cherishing small joys like today's,
I resolved to live my life.
